review_scope: Explicit selected UTF-8 report files only; no directory-driven selection.
manual_review: Read verification, inventories, README, cost/environment records and raw successful/failed diagnostic logs.
Inspected all five JUnit headers, test names, error/skip payloads and paths; parsed with DTD/entities/external access forbidden.
Verified all 18 source-inventory identities against the historical committed Git bodies, without executing those bodies.
retained_diagnostic_metadata: Generic scratch, interpreter, installed-package and synthetic-fixture path strings.
Generic /root/.local installed-package location strings; no private-home file contents.
Ephemeral container hostname and test timestamps in raw JUnit.
Public PyPI hostname and fixed public dependency filename in acquisition diagnostics.
excluded: SQLite/database snapshot bodies; hashes, columns, counts and fixture-presence flags only are retained.
Private-home contents, tokens/credentials, provider data, QA environments and dependency/package wheel bodies.
Generated fixture trees, runner source bodies and the preexisting broad receipt-inventory.json.
Licensed scanner rule bodies, source/package archives, whole-directory ZIPs and executable artifacts.

license_provenance.new_notes: Project-authored Apache-2.0 evidence notes and factual records.
license_provenance.raw_reports: Project-generated test/JUnit/tool diagnostics; original bytes retained.
license_provenance.tracebacks: Minimal diagnostic stack excerpts and package locations only, not bundled third-party implementation or rule bodies.
license_provenance.source_inventory: Hashes and sizes of committed source, not source body redistribution.
license_provenance.dependency_record: Version, filename, size, public origin and hash only; no wheel or third-party source copied.

scope_limit: A bounded content/provenance review, not a claim of universal secret detection or software licensing certification.
